# Lockstep

> An agent that keeps a devtools company's docs true to its code. For a pull request it walks a FalkorDB graph of code (Python symbols and call edges across repositories), docs (Markdown/MDX sections and code examples), maintainers' decisions and past verdicts; runs the impacted docs examples before and after the change in a sandbox; and proposes the docs fix with the graph path behind each paragraph.

Install: `npx -y lockstep-docs <command>` (Node 20+). Commands: `db start`, `index <owner/repo...>`, `check <pr-url> [--no-agent]`, `run <example-id> --pr <url>`, `decide <text> --governs <id...>`, `patch <pr-url> [--open-pr]`, `mcp`, `serve`, `facts`.

MCP: `claude mcp add lockstep -e FALKORDB_URL=falkor://localhost:6379 -- npx -y lockstep-docs mcp`. Tools: impact, clearance, read_section, run_example, decisions_for, rank_sections, propose_edit, record_verdict, write_decision, docs_patch. Every tool description includes its Cypher; every result lists the queries it ran.

Ids: Symbol `owner/repo:qualname`; DocSection `owner/repo:path#anchor`; CodeExample `owner/repo:path:index`.
